parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: This is the slider of a toaster, made of durable plastic, typically located on the side of the toaster.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to push down the bread carriage and start the toasting process.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward automatically after toasting.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: This is another slider component of the toaster, also made of plastic, possibly for controlling browning level or other settings.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to adjust the toasting intensity or other operational settings.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally or vertically depending on the design, allowing fine control of the toaster’s function.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toaster, made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the heating elements, electrical circuits, and provides slots for bread insertion.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed frame for all other moving parts.
